name: Sove

text: Deploy: Damage an enemy unit by 3. If the target is damaged, repeat the Deploy ability with a different target and decrease the damage by 1.

text: Whenever your Symbiosis is triggered, give the unit to the left Vitality (2). Order: Remove all Vitality from an allied unit, then boost self by the same amount.
